cutoff_semantics: force the daily flat at (16:00 ET - cutoff) and take no new entries after the cutoff (engine2.flat_before_close); flat_before_close=0 == baseline, bit-for-bit verified
null_policy: run Null C only for a market whose real grid clears dSharpe>=+0.10 and netR>=baseline
primary_metric: max-cell zero-trade-day daily net-ATR-R Sharpe uplift over the cutoff-0 baseline
kill_test: reject if NQ max-cell Sharpe uplift < +0.10, or (if real gate passes) Null C family-max upper-tail p > 0.05; weaken if Sharpe gain comes only from cutting net R, or sign does not transfer to ES
